Maya R.: Heads up - canary for verdant11b (int4) started spiking OOMs when we bumped batch_size from 4->8 and set max_new_tokens default to 512. Seen on 3 nodes in west-1.
Sam K.: logs?
Maya R.: pasted minimal snippet, filtered: 
``n2026-03-20T21:04:12Z ERROR oom: allocation failed: cudaMalloc 0x... size=1.2GiB
model=verdant11b-int4, batch=8, max_new_tokens=512, seq_len=2048
KV cache growth ~ +1.1GiB per request
```
Trevor (infra): that KV growth looks like no prefix compaction + prefetch enabled. Are we prefetching for this canary?
Maya R.: Prefetch flag on, warmup disabled. We used default kv_eviction_threshold=0.8 from the onboarding profile.
Lia (ml): Int4 can be more memory-sensitive; also Verdant's attention implementation uses a slightly larger KV per token. Suggests: drop default max_new_tokens -> 256 and re-enable warmup + slot_reserve 0.12.
Sam K.: Agree. Also try kv_eviction_threshold=0.6 and prefetch_size=128 to limit prefetch spike.
Trevor (infra): Quick note - fragmentation observed on these GPU kernels historically when allocations oscillate. We can run a defrag pass during coldstart: set gpu_defrag=true in runtime for canary.
deploy-bot: Canary deploy verdant11b-int4 -> 3 pods in eng-ml-canary
Maya R.: I ran a quick A/B: current canary (batch=8, max_new_tokens=512) failure rate 18% within 30m. Patch with settings below reduced to 1.5% in same workload.
Config applied:
```
batch_size: 4
max_new_tokens: 256
kv_eviction_threshold: 0.6
prefetch: true
prefetch_size: 128
slot_reserve: 0.12
gpu_defrag: true
```
Sam K.: Nice. Any quality regressions with these defaults (LLM outputs)?
Lia (ml): Did quick eval on our 200-sample sanity set - pass/fail metrics: Rouge/Exact-match within noise B11.2%. Quantization quality unchanged. So safe.
Trevor (infra): Recommend adding a short-lived fallback policy in routing: if FallbackOoms > 3 in 5m -> route to verdant11b-int8 variant (slower but stable).
Maya R.: Will add fallback and roll this patch. Also creating follow-up ticket to track longer-term: look into kernel allocator tune for verdant family to reduce fragmentation.
Sam K.: Can we update onboarding doc with these per-model defaults? I can PR: docs/onboarding/verdant11b.md with reasoning and numbers.
Lia (ml): Please also add a note to the eval harness about measuring KV growth per token for new models.
deploy-bot: Rollout complete: verdant11b-int4 canary patched -> healthy=3/3
Maya R.: Thanks - leaving canary for 6h and will monitor. If anything spikes I'll ping here.
Sam K.: Great, thanks Maya :) :thumbsup: 
Trevor (infra): Logged kernel-frag hypothesis in infra backlog.
Maya R.: Quick reminder: experiment files + raw logs uploaded to s3://redwood-inference/experiments/verdant11b/2026-03-20/ - contains mem profiles and perf dumps.
Lia (ml): 👍
